phases.name: Runner + containers + CI
phases.note: Ejecucion real disparada en el runner hospedado ubuntu-latest de GitHub Actions (no self-hosted, no disponible para este experimento): checkout limpio, npm ci, audit, build, lint, unit 10/10, provider-contract 6/6, migraciones desde cero, E2E 12/12, concurrencia 4/4. Primer intento fallo por una vulnerabilidad alta real (fast-uri) y se corrigio con npm audit fix (commit 2ec1e71); el segundo intento fue PASS completo.

phases.name: Fallos + seguridad + capacidad
phases.note: Webhook module implemented per docs/architecture/final/PROCESSING-QUEUES-WEBHOOKS.md: durable delivery, HMAC signing, canonical retry ladder (1m/5m/30m/2h/8h/24h then dead-letter), separate worker process (webhook-worker.ts), tenant RLS. Hard invariant (down endpoint never affects fiscal outcome) proven before and after a real failed attempt. 11/11 webhook fault-injection scenarios PASS (200/400/500/timeout/connection-refused/retries/backoff/dead-letter/two-endpoints/recovery/tenant-isolation). 4/4 additional fault-injection tests PASS (lease expiry recovered by a different worker instance, 40-op backlog drain with no loss/duplication, 15-way concurrent Idempotency-Key race, foreign UUID rejected without leakage). Secrets-in-logs verified against a real pino instance. Benchmark extended with real process/OS/PostgreSQL system metrics (fixed a Windows shell-escaping bug that made postgres metrics always null) and pushed to find real saturation: connection pool exhaustion at concurrency~=75 (DATABASE_POOL_MAX=30 ceiling), work_items queue depth growing unbounded (78->1048) as concurrency rises 75->761 with 0 HTTP errors throughout -- documented manually since the automated error-rate heuristic did not trip. 917-operation backlog drained fully in 22.1s by a real external worker process. Full pipeline (unit+provider-contract+e2e+concurrency, 48/48) PASS on a real hosted GitHub Actions run after fixing two CI-only flakes found along the way (verify-f6-behavior.sql lease too short for the extended pipeline; a new test not draining its own work item, contaminating the concurrency gate).
known_gaps: No literal OS-level process kill (kill -9) of API/worker to test restart -- the underlying recovery mechanism (lease expiry claimed by a different worker) is tested directly and deterministically instead; all 3 processes (API, fiscal worker, webhook worker) ran as real, independent OS processes for several minutes during the benchmark without crashing.
No real deployment/rollback infrastructure exists in this experiment; git revert + redeploy is documented as the honest interim mechanism, not fabricated against nonexistent infra.
